items.title: Smulyan interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: I was just flipping the radio dial and heard Fats Waller playing “African Ripples,” ... So you’d hear five nights of Fats Navarro, then the next night you’d hear five nights of Charlie Christian

ctx.x: That was an AHA moment. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -8-

It was a really amazing moment for me. I was just flipping the radio dial and heard Fats Waller playing “African Ripples,” which is a solo piano piece, and I’d never heard anything like that. I was completely knocked out. I was like what is this music and who is this piano player? And it was, that was a real life-defining moment, it really was. And it was a total accident. I was just listening to the radio and I just happened to come upon this and it was a jazz show called “Just Jazz” on WRBR, that was hosted by…
Has he ever heard that story?
